twbNotes.2026-07-13|DAVIS|De Pauw Selwyn: Started very well, 4-0. Good service, attacking, deep balls with spin, attacked short balls. twbNotes.2026-07-16|DAVIS|SERVONNAT Guillaume: Impressed too much by his level, good on both sides, complete overall. Average serve but with effect. Good drop shot, came to net. He struggled a bit with deep middle shots. I was successful only when building my points and attacked from inside court on his backhand, or attacked with spin on his forehand. What little worked for me was when I hit with a bit of punch. The revelation for me was how well worked when I stayed low and advanced when hitting. My backhand was better today because I hit it with more punch and let go. Another revelation was the volley when I watched him when coming to the net and timing my split step when he hits. My service was fine when I tried to have more punch. Things to remember: a bit more punch on my shots including the service, stay low and advance when hitting, timing the split step with him hitting the ball.
twbNotes.2026-07-17|BOIS CAMBRE|STANDAERT Félix: Solid, good slice backhand, reaching everything, nice drop shots, average service, vulnerable on middle high deep balls and high on backhand. I managed to stay in the set mentally and fought but couldn’t finish it when I had chances. Low and advance with the shot and a bit more punch worked again including backhand and service. Vulnerable on high backhands but when moving a bit back and turning shoulders more was much better. Service started to be good again because I started to let go again and hit with more punch. Volley is starting to be a thing, the only thing I changed was watching him when hitting, this makes me to stop and be ready. Resume: go for volley more and watch him when hitting, stay low and advance through shot plus punch, more back and turning shoulders for backhand, trust service, forehand down the line works

twbNotes.2026-08-09|OMBRAGE|LEWALLE Thierry: Solid player, good forehand, average serve. Had issues with my deep spin balls. I kept him back with middle spin deep balls, or with my forehand to his backhand high balls with spin. Long forehand cross rallies generally went my way. Shorter spin wide forehand crosses worked well. My service was great, 2nd kicked well. Slice backhand kept me in play and kept him from attacking. My drop shots were bad, timing them and technically. I played aggressively, went for my shots, stayed in the rallies and attacked short balls, not pushing the ball. Won first set and prepared for the usual relaxation but being prepared helped me having 3-0 in the 2nd. At that point I didn’t stayed in the moment, relaxed, and start thinking of the future, post match. He started to play offensive, came to the net, was very quickly 4-3 for him. I started to play again offensive, be in the present, thinking of the feet, broke him and finished the match.

I kept moving him left and right. At 5-3 I lost my service serving too protective and was 5-5 but realized I protected score, hit with more punch and won the set 7-5.
